SnowDistribution: A thin cover of soft snow on all aspects above 800 metres, a dusting below. Good visibility from late morning onwards.  Calm conditions.
Comment: Potential for localised areas of unstable windslab to develop from mid afternoon during Saturday.
WeatherInfluences: It is expected to be mostly dry with the potential for a few isolated snow showers. Light Westerly winds will back to become fresh South-Easterlies by mid afternoon. The freezing level will be between 600 and 800 metres.
SnowStability: Initially very little change to the overall snow cover which will remain on all aspects mainly above 800 metres.  During the afternoon as the wind speed increases there will be the potential for some light drifting.  This will lead to isolated and localised unstable windslab developing on West to North aspects above 1000 metres.  Areas most affected will be around the tops of gullies and coire rims.  The avalanche hazard will be Low.
ObservedWeatherInfluences: Light snowfall cleared during the morning to leave a dry sunny day. Winds were light Northerlies. Initially freezing at all levels before rising to 800 metres by midday.
ObservedSnowStability: There is a cover of soft snow above 800 metres on all aspects. Isolated and localised accumulations of generally well bonded windslab were observed on North-Westerly aspects above 1000 metres. The avalanche hazard is Low.
